title: Convert Number Words to Digits
summary: Given a string s consisting of lowercase English letters, extract and convert any valid number words to their corresponding digits, forming a resulting string of digits.
statement: Given a string s consisting of lowercase English letters, extract and convert any valid number words to their corresponding digits, forming a resulting string of digits. Parse the string from left to right: if a valid number word is found starting at the current position, append its digit to the result and move forward by the length of that word. If a valid number word is not found, skip one character and continue parsing. Return an empty string if no number words are found.
constraints: s contains up to 100,000 lowercase letters.
Scan left to right; when a complete English digit word begins at the current position, append its digit and consume the word.
Otherwise skip one character; return empty when no word is found.
hints: Only a complete number word beginning at the current scan position may be consumed.
Try the ten fixed words, append the matching digit, and jump by its full length; otherwise advance once.
Continue until the input is exhausted.
This directly follows the required left-to-right priority and prevents characters inside a consumed word from starting another match.

tests.explanation: The consecutive words one, four, and three produce 143.
Parse nine, skip x, then parse six to produce 96.
